parameters.signal_half_life: one update cycle of the source

formulas.name: fit
formulas.explanation: Centred cosine plus weighted distance in the 19-dim space; ML blended with alpha.

formulas.name: total_cost
formulas.explanation: Inflation-adjusted cost of the full course.

formulas.name: family_funds
formulas.explanation: Money the family can direct to education over the course.

formulas.name: loan_capacity
formulas.explanation: Present value of the maximum affordable EMI (annuity formula).

formulas.name: affordability
formulas.explanation: S = expected value of the best stack-compatible scholarship set.

formulas.name: roi
formulas.explanation: Earnings premium over a baseline path, discounted, per rupee spent.

formulas.name: conflict_index
formulas.explanation: Weighted parent-student gaps on 6 dimensions; bands aligned/mild/moderate/high.

formulas.name: final_score
formulas.expression: w_fit*fit + w_mkt*market + w_aff*afford + w_roi*roi + w_align*align - w_risk*disruption
formulas.explanation: Weights from the versioned scoring config; per-component contributions returned.

formulas.name: robustness
formulas.expression: mean Kendall tau(top-k base, top-k perturbed) over +/-20% weights
formulas.explanation: How stable the ranking is to reasonable changes in priorities.

formulas.name: likert_trait
formulas.expression: keyed = 6 - v if reverse else v;  trait = (mean(keyed) - 1) / 4
formulas.explanation: Agreement items, half of them reverse-worded where it matters, scored to 0-1.

formulas.name: aptitude_trait
formulas.expression: p = sum(w*correct)/sum(w), w = 1/1.5/2 by difficulty;  trait = max(0, (p - 1/4) / (3/4))
formulas.explanation: Difficulty-weighted accuracy corrected for guessing on four-option questions.

formulas.name: trait_reliability
formulas.expression: coverage * (0.5 + 0.5 * (1 - sd(keyed)/2)), then x0.5 straight-lining, x0.7 speeding, x0.6 contradiction
formulas.explanation: How much to trust one student's score on one trait; feeds recommendation confidence.

formulas.name: freshness
formulas.expression: fresh if age <= cadence, aging if <= 2*cadence, else stale; weight = 0.5^(age/half_life)
formulas.explanation: Data is judged against how often its publisher updates it, and older data counts less.

formulas.name: recommendation_confidence
formulas.explanation: Confidence falls when the inputs behind a recommendation are unverified, stale or imputed.

data_sources.source_name: Adzuna job-search API (India), Naukri JobSpeak monthly hiring index, EPFO monthly payroll data, Periodic Labour Force Survey (MoSPI), National Career Service portal
Adzuna job-search API (India), Periodic Labour Force Survey (MoSPI)

fairness_safeguards: Gender, caste, religion and community are never used as scoring or model features.
Recommendations are explained per component so families can challenge any single factor.
Admin analytics are k-anonymised (groups smaller than k=5 are suppressed).
privacy_rules: Parents see financial/aspiration inputs and aggregate results, not the student's raw answers.
Students see their own traits and a gentle conflict summary, not raw family finances.
Raw answers or raw finances are shared only with explicit, revocable consent.
Minors need recorded parental consent before data processing.
limitations: Figures not yet checked against a published source are labelled as estimates wherever they appear; each recommendation reports its checked share in data_trust.
Recommendations are computed live, but market data is only as current as its source: daily with the Adzuna feed enabled, otherwise the dated snapshot shown in /system/data-status.
Psychometric items are original and have not yet been validated on a large Indian sample; percentiles stay empty until 200 students in a grade band have taken them.
Career requirement profiles are expert priors until mapped to O*NET occupational data.
